notes.title: THE PLACE WHERE THE BIG SECRET STARTS
notes.content:
[h1]BIG UPDATE[/h1]

* The village where the player will start has been designed.
* Updated character animation systems.
* Sound and effects suitable for the concept have been added to the village.
* Animations of the people in the village were made.
* Various bugs fixed.
* Many optimizations have been made.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YXu430kNs6M
